Results.ReviewText: Great new grill, easy to light and cooks great.  Easy to move with all 4 wheels
Results.Title: Great New Grill

Results.ReviewText: I love my Weber. I would recommend this grill to everyone.  It’s easy to use and heats up quickly.
Results.Title: My Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, easy to assemble, easy to use. Affordable and efficient.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Built very well, holds in heat, used to have a 5 burner cheaper option and this one kicks its butt! Can grill when its freezing and snowing, its wonderful.
Results.Title: Built to Last

Results.ReviewText: Based on reviews I decided to spend a little more money and get a Weber grill. I am so glad I did. This is the best grill I have ever used. The E-310 is the perfect size for my family. It is solidly built, easy to ignite, and cooks superbly. I highly recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Well worth the money

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assembly; excellent heat distribution; easy to clean; only negative is some propane tanks too small for tank hole in base.
Results.Title: Weber E-310 Review

Results.ReviewText: Wife bought it for me. Love it so far! Reliable and impressive.
Results.Title: Great quality for the price.

Results.ReviewText: Good features, appears well-constructed, good value with sale.
Results.Title: Happy Purchase

Results.ReviewText: I got this BBQ for my 69th birthday July 2023? I like the quality of Weber bbq,s and they last don't rust out after one summer. I one issue with this unit and that is the tank built in tank weight measuring system.  Unless I'm missing something in order to load the tank on to the weight scale you have to lift the tank while it's inside the grill. This is neither easy or convenient especially if you have a bad back. Pls advise if I have missed a better method.
Results.Title: Sprint purchased July 2023

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. Your satisfaction is very important to us. So sorry to hear you are not completely satisfied and are having a hard time connecting the propane tank. Our Care team is here to help. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Not worth it. Cheaply made. Extremely hard to hook up propane tank.

Results.ReviewText: Our grille is fairly new. We've used it several times. It starts reliably, and stays true to temperature set. So far we are happy with it.
Results.Title: Grille does it's job well

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Spirit E-310 as my first was Crushed during hurricane Helene !! I had always enjoyed grilling on the grill, so I had to purchase another.
Results.Title: Crushed grill replaced

Results.ReviewText: I love Weber grill-my other Weber grill I received in 1988 new,it lasted until this year 36 years old-I only wish it was able to be connected to natural gas
Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText: Cheap stainless steal and it's a rust bucket. Over-priced, mediocre quality. Parts are stupid expensive and it's a hassle to get them. D-
Results.Title: Look elsewhere

Results.ReviewText: We’ve had Weber charcoal grills for 50 years, but this is our first Weber Gas Grill. We’re enjoying the ease of use of the gas version.
Results.Title: 50 year Weber customer

Results.ReviewText: The grill works good, just like my last grill which I won't mention the name but cost a 3rd of this one. I'm looking for an hoping for long-term use. 10 year warranty that's what sold me.
Results.Title: Got it for the long haul

Results.ReviewText: I like the ease of lighting this grill, and controlling the temperature. 10 year warranty is awesome.
Results.Title: Easy to use

Results.ReviewText: We have been Weber Grill owners for 35 years. In that time we have had three Weber Grills!  The most important part of grilling is the grill itself. Over the years we have become expert grillers because of the weather products! We don’t even look at other grills. Only a Weber for us! We did have a bit of a problem with a dented piece of frame. Contacted Weber direct support. Nothing short of excellence in support. Received replacement part in about three days.
Results.Title: Hello, it’s a Weber grill!

Results.ReviewText: Just my weber gas grill with this new Spirit E-310. My last weber grill lasted 9 years and was outside on my patio in southwest Florida year-round. This grill is just like the last one I owned has three burners just the right size for my wife and I with a few guests
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Simple to operate, easy to clean and move, tank fuel gage solid/necessary feature.  Good steady heat, essential for grilling.  Reasonable price.👨🏻‍🍳🇺🇸
Results.Title: Grillone

Results.ReviewText: I love this three burner grill. I grill 5 nights a week and have worn out two of the same grills over the past 15 years. Easy to light, gets plenty hot ( 500 degrees ), top rack ideal for chicken thighs ( 25 minutes at 350 degrees - perfect), nice gas level gauge, pretty easy to deep clean and holds up well. The only thing I replace is the flavor bars after about 250 uses. Well worth the money - everything you need and none of the extra stuff you don't. I always pay to have it assembled as assembly can be pretty time consuming.
Results.Title: Great Gas BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Always love the Weber grills.  This one is well constructed and fires up easily.  Didn’t need or want a larger grill as we usually only grill for 2-4 people.
Results.Title: Good Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: Gracious, do they have too much time on their hands?  I get 4-5  emails a day from Weber, far too much and irritatingly so.  What is up with them?
Results.Title: OMG, four or five e mails a day

Results.ReviewText: After almost 20 years I retired my last Weber three burner grill. I was happy with the service it gave me, I only had to replace the grates and smoke bars a couple of times in that time
Results.Title: Durable good materials

Results.ReviewText: Perfect grill for small family. It does everything you need it to. Easy to move and easy to clean. Highly recommended.
Results.Title: The perfect grill doesn’t exi…

Results.ReviewText: Love it! I love the design and the ease of use. My steaks and tri-tips always turn out perfect and with beautiful gridlines.
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: My last Weber Spirit (same size) lasted 13 years so I wanted another one. This one performs fine, no complaints on actually grilling on it so far. However, during assembly I noticed a pretty significant drop in overall quality compared to my last one. The grill has an open back rather than fully enclosed. Everything feels cheaper on it, the steel, burners, drip bars, handles, etc.... I am hoping it's all just cosmetic, but I will be surprised to get anywhere near the lifespan out of this one. Other than that I feel like it still is the best option within that price range. I also have had good experiences replacing worn parts with Weber's so that's reassuring. I wish weber would make these in the USA with a little better attention to quality.
Results.Title: Good Grill, But Make Them Great Again

Results.ReviewText: We recently purchased a condo, this is the Perfect grill for us….small but big enough to grill for a large group…..heats nicely - haven’t found any hot spots yet….Highly recommend this - the price was right too.
Results.Title: Perfect

Results.ReviewText: Wonderfull support from Weber on the grill burner tubes. They replaced them and we got them really FAST.
Results.Title: Great Service

Results.ReviewText: We had a larger grill and decided to size down. We love it. Plenty of grilling surface for our large family.
Results.Title: Great Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. So sorry to hear your new grill arrived  damaged. Your satisfaction is very important to us. We are here to help and will be sure to get this resolved for you quickly. Our Care team will be reaching out to assist you further. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: As many others on Amazon have said, grill arrived with dents and scrapes. Wasn't a shipping or packing problem, fresh out of the box and already damaged. Also as others have mentioned, the hood cover came with a sticker\label and when peeled off left a glue residue. Try to clean it off but no luck, and with the first heating it was burned into the finish. Who thought this was a good idea, not the same old Weber I am used to.  Just replaced a 17 year old Weber gas grill so was confident of the quality, was I wrong. Amazon's delivery team was great, reported the problem, but then I had to deal with Amazon and Weber to correct the issues. Saw the same damage in other reviews. Nothing special any more, quality is not there.
Results.Title: Spirit Grill damaged out of the box

Results.ReviewText: I have had this grill for nine years.  It is used frequently.  Recently the burners deteriorated to the point the temperature couldn't be controlled.  I called Weber.  The burners have a 10 year warranty.  They sent new burners, no questions asked.  We're grilling again just like when it was new.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber makes the best in all categories.  I just keep waiting for Weber to make a pellet grill.
Results.Title: Weber brilliance

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill. Easy to put together even easier to cook with. One down side is I wish it came with a griddle insert not sold separately.
Results.Title: Easy cooking.

Results.ReviewText: This is a quality unit that is relatively compact, so it uses less space on a patio or in a garage. I have enjoyed cooking many proteins on it, from burgers and steaks, to fish, chicken, kabobs, etc.
Results.Title: Quality Compact Grill

Results.ReviewText: I mostly like the product except for 2 design flaws in my opinion.  There is no backside panel on it.  The wind can really blow thru it.  It kept blowing the grease pan out of it.  Also you have to hang the propane tank.  That is good if you the grill to keep track on how much propane you have left, but I find it hard to hang due to the weight of a full tank and you have to do it because there is no other place to put it.
Results.Title: Some people would call these design flaws

Results.ReviewText: Nice consistent fire and heat.  Grill surface is a little smaller than my old 2012 E310 Genesis and the whole grill is much lighter to maneuver around the deck.  The grill handle is plastic with many small slats compared to the metal cylinder handle.  It may attract many small bugs to make a home in them while sitting idol. Overall very happy with it.
Results.Title: 3rd Weber grill owner.

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
